interaction: Caller invokes normalize_labels synchronously; there is no UI, request, storage operation or external interaction.

function_contract.name: normalize_labels
function_contract.input: Array of values, with UTF-8 strings as valid elements.
function_contract.success: A string array containing nonempty, trimmed, unique values in first-occurrence order.

failure.condition: Any input element is not a string.
failure.error_kind: NonStringElement (conceptual name, not a chosen language exception type).
failure.index: Original input index, proposed zero-based; choose the lowest invalid index.
failure.partial_result: Absent; failure does not return any success array.

function_contract.out_of_domain: Top-level non-array input and invalid UTF-8 encoding are not specified by the original request; this design adds no new behavior for them.

normalization_rules: Trim Unicode whitespace only at the leading and trailing boundaries.
Preserve interior text and interior whitespace.
Do not convert case, perform Unicode normalization, sort, coerce non-strings, or deduplicate before trimming.
Compare the exact trimmed string representation; canonically equivalent but differently encoded sequences are not merged by an added normalization step.
Filter the empty result after trimming before membership checks.

algorithm.rule: Walk the original input in index order; on a non-string return the whole-call error immediately.
Allocate a local empty output array and exact-equality membership set after type validation succeeds.
For each original string, compute its Unicode-whitespace boundary trim. Skip empty strings. Append only when absent from the set.
Return the finished array; no caller-provided collection is changed.

complexity.proposed_set_implementation: Expected O(N + B) time for N elements and B total text size, assuming a conventional hash set with expected constant-time membership and text-proportional hashing.
complexity.auxiliary_space: O(U + S), for U unique output entries and S retained output text; exact allocation depends on the later implementation language.
complexity.caveat: These are design estimates, not measured runtime evidence.

reuse_and_files.existing_code_reuse: Not assessed; repository source is outside this bound offline exercise.

review_vectors.purpose: Empty and ASCII-whitespace-only elements are discarded.
Proposed Unicode-whitespace predicate must recognize the specified non-ASCII whitespace, and equality applies after trimming.
Case sensitivity and stable first occurrence.
Whole-call failure; first invalid input index.

validation_plan.success_checks: Compare actual output arrays against each approved review vector using exact string equality and ordering.
validation_plan.negative_checks: For each non-string position assert whole-call failure, original offending index, absent success result and unchanged input.
validation_plan.side_effect_checks: When an implementation is separately authorized, verify the function has no network/storage dependencies and leaves caller input unchanged.
validation_plan.unicode_checks: Before implementation acceptance, freeze the Unicode-whitespace predicate/version and add boundary coverage for that exact predicate.
validation_plan.current_evidence: Only design artifact consistency is checked in this exercise; no function implementation or runtime test exists.

release_boundary.actual_authority: Task artifacts only; no implementation, real approval or deployment.
